title: CoherentPushforwardIdeal
statement: Let $X$ be locally Noetherian and $i:W\to X$ a closed immersion with $W$ integral. For every quasi-coherent ideal $I$ on $W$, $i_*I$ is coherent.

proof.text: A closed immersion is finite, so W is locally Noetherian. The structure module of W and the pushed structure module of the subscheme defined by I are coherent by the structure-module and finite-pushforward clauses. I.toModules is their comparison kernel, so coherent kernel closure proves coherence of I; finite pushforward along i proves the conclusion, including zero and unit ideals. Apply the shared non-Noetherian finite-pushforward finite-type theorem, and the existing coherence criterion on the locally Noetherian target. Structure modules have finite presentation because they are invertible, and are quasi-coherent by the existing structure-module theorem. No duplicated finite-pushforward, structure-coherence, restriction or denominator theorem is declared.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01YH; canonical kernel and stalk comparison construction, using the shared finite-type pushforward theorem without the cyclic finite-pushforward coherence import

theorem coherent_pushforward_ideal {X W : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (i : W ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral W]
    (I : W.IdealSheafData) :
    RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace ((pushforward i).obj I.toModules)
